bash -euo pipefail <<'SETUP'
mkdir -p /workspace/hermes-browsers/box && cd /workspace/hermes-browsers/box
base=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leonsiliconAI/hermes-plugin-leon/7508f60af76104d31450f3b599138d0581ea8179/grok_box_browser/box
curl -fsSLO "$base/up.sh"; curl -fsSLO "$base/broker.mjs"
printf '%s  up.sh\n%s  broker.mjs\n' aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb | sha256sum -c -
umask 077; printf %s 'tok-123' > ../token
bash up.sh
SETUP
